tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List off-plan projects from the site catalogue. Filter by area, developer, budget, handover year or free text. Returns name, developer, area, starting price, handover, unit types and the page URL. Sold-out projects are excluded unless include_sold_out is true.

tools.name: get_project_details
tools.description: Fetch every stored fact for one project: developer, area, starting price, handover, ownership, DLD fee, payment plan, unit mix, amenities, distances, FAQ and description. Accepts a slug or a project name.

tools.name: compare_projects
tools.description: Compare 2-4 projects side by side. Accepts slugs or project names; anything that cannot be resolved is reported in not_found.

tools.name: list_developers
tools.description: List the developers that have a profile page on this site, with the page URL and how many catalogue projects each one has. Use it for "which developers build in RAK" or to look a developer up before filtering projects.

tools.name: list_areas
tools.description: List the Ras Al Khaimah area guides published on this site, with the guide URL, its on-page summary and how many catalogue projects sit in each area.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Free-text search across the whole site: projects, developer pages, area guides, informational guide pages and blog articles. Use this for any question the project tools do not answer directly (buying process, freehold ownership, visas, mortgages, fees, market news) and cite the pages it returns.
